slot.brief: Determine intervals where a polynomial/rational function is increasing or decreasing by sign analysis of f′(x).

verdicts.working: f'(x)=3x(x-2)<0 for 0<x<2, so f is decreasing on (0,2).

working:

Independent check: f'(x)=3x(x-2)<0 for 0<x<2, so f is decreasing on (0,2).
solution:
A function is decreasing where $f'(x)<0$. Here,
$$f'(x)=3x(x-2)<0 \quad\text{for }0<x<2.$$
Hence, $f$ is decreasing on $(0,2)$.
